protocol.pairing: planners on the same snapshots, policies on the same networks
protocol.test: Wilcoxon signed-rank, exact sign permutation below six pairs
protocol.family_correction: Holm step-down within each family of comparisons
protocol.relative_interval: percentile bootstrap of the ratio of means, 10,000 resamples, 95 percent

source.fill: Wyndham City Council smart-bin fill level, daily, Creative Commons Attribution 2.5 Australia
source.weather: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0); ERA5 reanalysis, Copernicus Climate Change Service; UV index, Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service

definition.outcome: rise in fill between two consecutive daily readings, share of container
definition.kept: pairs with no fall and a first reading of at most 0.6
definition.temperature: mean of the two daily maximum temperatures, per 10 C, centred at 20.0 C
definition.wet: the two days together received at least 2.0 mm
definition.model: Poisson pseudo maximum likelihood, log link, container fixed effects, day of week, restriction period; standard errors clustered by date

google.attribution: Source: Includes weather data from Google

protocol.price_sweep_instance: synthetic: depot and one container on a two-node symmetric distance matrix, constant 20 km/h, no congestion, 1100 L container half full at 220 kg per cubic metre, 4 min service, 15 min tipping, no overflow deadline, shift 1200 min
protocol.tightness_instance: synthetic: n containers each 10 km from the depot on its own spoke, travel between containers through the depot, shift sized to fit exactly r spokes, all waits start at zero
